According to the capability manifest:
- `searchClientName`: 仅表示客户本人的人名；不表示客户集合、公司/机构名称、地址、产品名... "意健险" is a product name, not a person name.
- `pcustSourcType`: 该字段表示准客来源，不表示有效短险保单；必须有"准客/准客来源"等来源语义。裸"意健险客户"表示有效短险保单，应映射到validSinsPol
- `validSinsPol`: 该字段仅表示是否有效短险保单，不表示准客来源... enums: ["综拓", "O2O", "意健险"]

So "意健险" is an enum value of validSinsPol (有效短险保单). The user query "意健险" (bare word) should be mapped to validSinsPol CONTAINS "意健险" (holding valid short-term insurance policy of type 意健险).

The actual output mapped it to searchClientName MATCH "意健险" — treating the product name as a customer name. This is wrong.
